units.source_text: 驹子一口气说了这么许多，但是陪他回来的那位姑娘是谁？

en.t: Komako had said so much all in one breath, but who was the young woman who had come back with him?

units.source_text: 她为什么住在这人家里？

en.t: Why was she living in this household?

units.source_text: 对于这些，驹子却依然只字未提。

en.t: About all this, however, Komako still did not say a single word.

units.source_text: 在像是悬在半空中的这间房子里，驹子即便只说了这些，她的声音也会在每个角落里旋荡。

en.t: In this room that seemed to hang in midair, even saying only that much, Komako's voice would swirl through every corner.
